preRegistered: squad11-core.mjs header + RULES (24 Oct 2026, before any run) + data/strategy-library.json SQ11-*
standard: both halves (signal before / from 2024-01-01): > 0 after 0.8% and 1.2% cost, better than the average liquid stock bought and sold at the same moments (rule and yardstick capped at +300%, AUD-1), better than the same stock held as long on its other days, > 0 without the 2 best, 20+ trades and 3+ blocks, block t >= 2.5, return per year of capital tied up above SPY on the same days -> TRADABLE SMALL; block t >= 4.07 -> PROVEN

SQ11-PB8.name: Leader pullback: first close 8% under its 50-day high, still above its 200-day (hold 63)
SQ11-PB8.rule: Leader (top 20% by 12-1 month return among the 300 largest US companies by market value at the prior month end). Signal: the first close >= 8% under the highest close of the last 50 sessions (today included) while the close is above the 200-session average (the previous close was less than 8% under its own 50-session high). Buy the next open; sell at the close of session 63.

SQ11-PB12.name: Leader pullback: first close 12% under its 50-day high, still above its 200-day (hold 126)
SQ11-PB12.rule: Leader (as SQ11-PB8). Signal: the first close >= 12% under the highest close of the last 50 sessions while the close is above the 200-session average (the previous close was less than 12% under its own 50-session high). Buy the next open; sell at the close of session 126.

SQ11-MA50.name: Leader touches its 50-day average from above (hold 63)
SQ11-MA50.rule: Leader (as SQ11-PB8). Signal: today's low <= the 50-session average of the closes, and each of the 10 previous closes was above its own 50-session average. Buy the next open; sell at the close of session 63.

SQ11-3DN.name: Leader after 3 down days in a row (hold 21)
SQ11-3DN.rule: Leader (as SQ11-PB8). Signal: the third down close in a row (close below the previous close on t, t-1 and t-2) and the close of t-3 not below that of t-4. Buy the next open; sell at the close of session 21.

SQ11-FLUSH.name: Leader drops 5%+ on a day SPY drops 2%+ (market-wide selloff, hold 63)
SQ11-FLUSH.rule: Leader (as SQ11-PB8). Signal: the leader's close is 5%+ under the previous close on a session when SPY's close is 2%+ under its previous close. Buy the next open; sell at the close of session 63. (No point-in-time news check exists; the SPY condition makes the drop market-wide.)

SQ11-20D.name: Leader's first close under its 20-day average after a 3-month run of 20%+ (hold 21)
SQ11-20D.rule: Leader (as SQ11-PB8). Signal: close below its 20-session average; each of the 20 previous closes at or above its own 20-session average; close of t-1 / close of t-64 - 1 >= 20%. Buy the next open; sell at the close of session 21.

SQ11-MS63.name: CONTROL: buy every leader at the month start (fixed date, hold 63)
SQ11-MS63.rule: Every leader (as SQ11-PB8) bought at the open of the first session after each month end (signal = the month-end close); sell at the close of session 63; one open trade per stock (a leader still held is not bought again).
